## Effect-witness policy

A mutation response is never sufficient evidence. Every effect-witness obligation must observe resulting state through an independent read path and preserve durable identity or content-hash evidence.

### VO-d982977672dda011fc65 — Given all sources are healthy, When work changes state, Then the correlated governance view reflects the authoritative source change within the freshness objective.
